meta.title: HSK 3.0 Level 2 — Mandarin Chinese
meta.subtitle: 746 words · both directions, as two subdecks
meta.desc: Both study directions in one deck, as subdecks you can add and study separately: Chinese → English (see the characters, recall the meanings and the pinyin) and English → Chinese (see an English meaning, recall the characters and the pinyin). The official HSK 3.0 Level 2 vocabulary — the 2021 standard, not the older HSK 2.0 syllabus. Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the full range of English translations rather than a single gloss. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 369 of the 746 words. The official list has 771 rows and this deck has 746 cards; the difference is duplication rather than anything left out. The syllabus lists a character again wherever it introduces a new sense, and a Folio card shows every sense a word has, so a word is carded at the level it first appears — 17 of this level's words are in the Level 1 or Level 2 deck instead. Where the syllabus lists a character twice at the SAME level it has two readings to learn, and it gets one card showing both, with the senses grouped under the reading they belong to. Word list: the official HSK 3.0 (2021) syllabus. Definitions, readings and measure words: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0).
